findings.problem: §8 'Configuration (mpd.jsonc)' table lists `codegraph.*` as an mpd.jsonc key consulted by mpd-codegraph ('autoInit, binary, timeouts'). No plugin reads a codegraph.* config key from mpdConfig: packages/mpd-codegraph-plugin/src/index.ts takes autoInit/initTimeoutMs/cooldownMs/binary from its bundle-patch ROW config, and the authoritative consumed-key list (mpd_config_get's description) does not mention codegraph. A user writing codegraph.* into .mpd/mpd.jsonc would silently get nothing.
findings.requiredFix: Remove the `codegraph.*` row from the mpd.jsonc table in docs/user-guide.md and docs/user-guide.zh-CN.md (line 223), or rewrite it to say these are apply-time row options, not mpd.jsonc keys.
